{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Filter to the TREATMENT arm
treatment_arm = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Check number of patients in treatment arm
print(f"Number of patients in treatment arm: {len(treatment_arm)}")

# Compute the fraction who responded
fraction_responded = treatment_arm['responded'].mean()
print(f"Fraction responded: {fraction_responded}")

# Also confirm no missing values in 'responded'
print(f"Missing values in 'responded': {treatment_arm['responded'].isnull().sum()}")"}
